{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "optics_normal",
      "alarms_cleared",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older transmission units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disabling and enabling the interface once",
    "avoid": [
      "sfp.replace",
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Before replacing the SFP again or rebooting the unit, check the traffic counters.\n\nIf the interface is UP but the counters remain at zero, try disabling and enabling the interface once.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": true,
    "outcome_confirmed": false,
    "outcome_excerpt": null
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a reusable troubleshooting rule for older transmission units where traffic counters remain at zero after SFP replacement."
}
